0: Me hanga e tatou he awa o nga utu o ia marama i te wa tonu.
1: Akohia me pehea te mahi a te bitcoin mai i te pepa tukutuku ma.
2: Ngaro nga mea ngaro i to putea. Ka tukuna e te waa to kirimana tuuruhi.
3: Tīpakohia he putea putea Bitcoin (BCH) i runga ake nei.
4: Kitea me te tuhi i o kupu tekau ma rua.
5: Hunaia he kape o au kupu ngaro i tetahi waahi rereke.
6: Ko au kupu ngaro ka mau i au moni; Kaore he kupu, kaore he moni.
7: Tāruahia to wāhitau mai i to putea.
8: Whakapirihia to wahitau putea ki tenei taupānga.
9: Tuhia to kirimana mo ia marama.
10: A tai'o faahou i te apiti mo te marama mo te marama.
12: Tahua tika i to kirimana tuuturu, me te tiri ranei.
13: Koina tena, i mahia e koe. Kua wikitoria koe!
14: I toa koe i etahi umanga ki te ako,
16: Ko te whiwhinga moni he huarahi ki te kaainga.
17: Ka taea e te tari te whakamanawanui i etahi atu.
18: Kaua rawa e hoatu to mana,
19: ... Engari te arotake i to mahere, ina e tika ana.
short_01: Whakaputa i to kirimana tuuturu marama.
receive: Whakauruhia to wahitau Bitcoin Bitlet Bittele (BCH)
overview: Waihangahia he kirimana hei tohatoha mo te kotahi miriona o te pauna marama i te wa tonu.
